verdict.rationale: Instinct connects to the user's email, messaging, calendar, Drive, location and other data (docs-2, docs-5). It turns that data into proactive suggestions: following up on dropped threads, summarizing emails, and nudging about forgotten items, which testers confirmed hands-on, e.g. it spotted an overdue medical appointment and acted with context right after onboarding (docs-3, docs-9, comm-4, comm-8, comm-17). missing for 10: first-party documentation describing how insights and suggestions are generated or surfaced, and evidence of analytical insights beyond follow-ups, nudges and summaries delivered via text or call.
